scoring_note: This rescore uses the exact same 800 held-out generations from evaluation-smollm.json. MCQ success requires both the expected answer key and exact normalized answer text. Short answers are scored after stripping a leading option key. Flashcard correctness is scored from the JSON back field after stripping a leading option key. Revision correctness is scored from the Answer line. Format validity is reported separately from factual correctness. No test examples or scoring rules were changed to inflate accuracy.
conclusion: Not production-ready for factual study answers. Formatting is mostly valid, but factual answer accuracy is poor and far below the near-perfect target.
